name: gtrk
description: Agent-native video creation: turn your own footage into an editable multi-track project (talking-head cuts, highlights, narration, B-roll, motion graphics, captions) and export to Jianying/CapCut, Premiere XML, FCPXML or OTIO. Requires the gtrk CLI (npm @gitruck/cli).

hooks.command: command -v gtrk >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo '[gtrk] gtrk CLI not found. The plugin ships the Skills only; before running a gtrk Skill, ask the user to install the CLI and set an API key with: npx -y @gitruck/cli@latest install（未检测到 gtrk CLI：先运行上面这条命令安装并配置 API Key）'
